name: rate-limit
nudge: You appear to have stalled on a transient API rate-limit (server-side, not your usage quota). The limit should have cleared — please continue your work where you left off.
comment: Anthropic server-side capacity throttle (NOT the account quota). Leaves the agent idle mid-flow. Nudge resumes the SAME session (preserves work); restart would lose it + re-hit the limit. verify-resumed self-corrects a nudge into a still-active throttle (back off + retry).

name: turn-aborted
signature: (Request was aborted|aborted by user|API Error: Connection error)
nudge: Your last turn aborted before completing. Please continue your work where you left off.
comment: A turn that died on a transient connection/abort error, leaving the agent idle. Same resume-not-restart logic.
